name: Mont Tremblant
terrain_source: NRCan HRDEM 1 m lidar mosaic, gaps from MRDEM 30 m (Open Government Licence - Canada) (1 m lidar 100%)
rename_notes: OpenStreetMap names matched to the resort's trail report (mtnpowder feed 4) and its 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 49178): Upper/Lower = Haut/Bas; Alpine became Roger McCarthy in 2025 and Ligne de Pente became Lucile Wheeler for 2026-27 (both seen on the maps, same run numbers 7 and 30)
as_runs_notes: tagged snow_park in OpenStreetMap but on the resort's trail list as runs: Curé Deslauriers (33), Promenade (35), Sissy Schuss (79, the whole run; only a 217 m piece was tagged downhill), Roger McCarthy (7, two pieces named Alpine); Dernier Cri Bas (lower Dernier Cri, 21, through Le P'tit Parc)

drop_ways.1430685422: unnamed 96 m piece crossing the top of Fuddle Duddle as an X, its top end leads nowhere (not on the trail map)
drop_ways.1430685423: unnamed 88 m piece crossing the top of Fuddle Duddle as an X, its bottom end leads nowhere (not on the trail map)

extra_trails.name: Short Cut
extra_trails.why: OpenStreetMap stops Marie-Claude Asselin, Banzaï and Tunnel about 160 m above the top of Short Cut; on the trail map (2025-26 and 2026-27) all three run out into the open area where Short Cut starts. Drawn through their three ends to the top of Short Cut (flat ground, 676 to 670 m)
